# Chris Parsons

> Chris Parsons is a tech founder, CTO, and AI leadership advisor. He helps CEOs and exec teams cut through the AI hype and leverage AI to transform their companies. He writes about AI strategy, AI agents, developer tooling, and practical AI adoption for technical leaders.

- Site: [chrismdp.com](https://www.chrismdp.com)
- RSS: [chrismdp.com/feed.xml](https://www.chrismdp.com/feed.xml)
- Newsletter: Weekly AI insights for leaders
- Services: AI transformation, CEO and exec team advisory, whole-team upskilling, AI Leader Accelerator programme

## Services

Chris helps companies transform how they work with AI:

- **CEO and Exec Team Advisory**: Unrestricted ad-hoc access for CEOs, founders, and exec teams. Covers rollout sequencing, AI-proficient hiring, token economics, AI ownership, vendor selection, and board communication.
- **Whole-Team Upskilling**: Hands-on workshops from a two-hour executive briefing to multi-day programmes, with tailored pathways for developers, product managers, researchers, and executives. Transform random ChatGPT usage into systematic AI workflows with security and quality standards built in.
- **AI Leader Accelerator**: 8-week peer learning programme for senior technical leaders navigating AI adoption.

Email chris@chrismdp.com for enquiries. Subscribe to the newsletter via the web form at [chrismdp.com](https://www.chrismdp.com/) to access a vault of high-resolution guides, infographics, and weekly AI insights.
